generation.subject_description_en: One silver-white fine-chain necklace with a single near-round two-tier floral pendant, a scalloped outer petal halo, an inner four-lobed cluster, dense colorless pave-like stones, and two side attachment rings.
generation.wearing_instruction_en: Wear the single necklace naturally at the base of the neck, with the complete chain and centered floral pendant clearly visible.
generation.macro_focus_en: Focus on the layered floral silhouette, scalloped outer halo, inner four-lobed cluster, dense small colorless stones, and the two side attachment rings.
generation.gift_presentation_en: Arrange the complete necklace naturally on a necklace insert, with the chain supported and the single floral pendant centered and unobstructed.
integrity_constraints_en: preserve one necklace and one pendant only
preserve the fine oval-link chain and both side attachment rings
preserve the two-tier floral silhouette and its proportions
preserve the silver-white color and dense colorless stone appearance
forbidden_additions_en: no earrings, rings, bracelets, watches, or other accessories
no gold conversion or colored gemstones
no altered flower outline or attachment geometry
